title: Dutch PHP Conference 2022 - Schedule
content:
We are thrilled to present the schedule of the Dutch PHP Conference 2022. This conference is a Online Edition, full of high-level technical sessions. Last year we welcomed visitors from a whopping 55+ countries! We hope to host another great and globally online edition of DPC this year. FREE

! You can register now

We look forward to virtually meeting you on June 24! Mark those calendars!
author: PHP.net news & announcements
